financials_multi_year.source: Ukrenergo FY2025 Financial Statements / Fitch Ratings Oct-26 Assessment, read 25-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY25 EBITDA UAH 8.4bn per Fitch Ratings; Fitch projects FY26 EBITDA ~UAH 4.0bn due to grid attacks & balancing deficits before recovery.

capital_structure_tranches.instrument: Mavka Finance Secured Reconstruction Notes 7.2967% due Oct 2041
capital_structure_tranches.tranche_name: Mavka Finance Secured Reconstruction Notes 7.2967% due Oct 2041
capital_structure_tranches.observation: Backed by sovereign guarantee and US DFC political risk insurance (Oct-26 debt-for-energy swap).
Issued in Oct-26 restructuring of $825m 6.875% 2028 green bonds (97.49% consent).

debt_maturities.source: Oct-26 Mavka Finance debt-for-energy swap ($494.75m 2041 DFC-insured + $395m 2031 unsecured; saved ~$135m debt service).

verdict.stance: Overweight (Mavka DFC-Insured) / Landmark Oct-26 Debt-for-Energy Swap (Fitch CCC)
verdict.summary: Ukrenergo closed its landmark Oct-2026 restructuring of $825m 2028 green bonds (97.49% bondholder participation) into DFC-insured Mavka Finance 2041 reconstruction notes ($494.75m at 7.30%) and unsecured 2031 notes ($395m at 8.50%), generating ~$135m in debt-service savings earmarked for HV grid repairs and earning a Fitch upgrade to CCC.

positives: Oct-26 restructuring achieved 97.49% participation and ~$135m debt-service savings.
Mavka Finance 2041 tranche carries sovereign guarantee + US DFC political risk insurance.
Natural monopoly over Ukraine's high-voltage electricity transmission grid (ENTSO-E synchronized).
negatives: Continuous Russian strikes on high-voltage substations compressing FY26 EBITDA (~UAH 4bn Fitch est vs UAH 8.4bn FY25).
Balancing market payment deficits from state distribution/PSO counterparties.

background.business_overview: Ukraine's state-owned high-voltage electricity transmission system operator (TSO).
background.asset_perimeter: National HV transmission grid and cross-border ENTSO-E interconnectors.

recent_drivers: Oct-26: Closed $825m green bond debt-for-energy swap via Mavka Finance DAC (XS3450183101 & XS3526064210); Fitch upgraded to CCC.

catalysts.event: First Semi-Annual Mavka Finance Coupon & Grid Repair Verification
catalysts.impact: Tests DFC-backed debt-service mechanics and transmission tariff collections.

management_guidance_tracker.variance_analysis: Fitch upgraded IDR to CCC following settlement.

management_questions.question: Confirm ENTSO-E import/export capacity revenues and 2027 NEURC transmission tariff sufficiency post-restructuring.
management_questions.relevance: Drives post-2026 EBITDA recovery from UAH 4bn trough.
